description:
optional, enumerated string filter
Status of the migration. Possible values are : moved_in, moved_out, moving_out.
Supported operators : is, is_not, in, not_in

Example → status[is] = "MOVED_OUT"

is.description: \* \`moved_in\` - Moved in from another cb site \* \`moved_out\` - Moved out from one cb site to another \* \`moving_out\` - Moving out from one cb site to another

is_not.description: \* \`moved_in\` - Moved in from another cb site \* \`moved_out\` - Moved out from one cb site to another \* \`moving_out\` - Moving out from one cb site to another
